# Hashtag Web3 — API Scoped Context

> Scoped documentation for querying Hashtag Web3 REST APIs, versioning policies, pagination, and error envelopes.

## Base URLs
- Production: `https://hashtagweb3.com/api/v1` (or `https://hashtagweb3.com/api`)
- Sandbox: `https://hashtagweb3.com/api/v1?env=sandbox` or send `X-Sandbox: true` header.

## Public Endpoints
- `GET /api/v1/jobs`: Filter by `search`, `tag`, `company`, `limit`, `offset`, or `cursor`.
- `GET /api/v1/news`: Crypto industry headlines with `search` and `limit`.
- `GET /api/v1/events`: Conferences and hackathons with `search`, `type`, `country`.
- `GET /api/v1/glossary`: 200+ blockchain definitions with `search`, `category`.
- `POST /api/v1/jobs/batch`: Bulk operations endpoint.
- `POST /api/v1/jobs/export`: Async jobs export (returns 202 Accepted).
- `POST /ask`: Microsoft NLWeb query endpoint with SSE streaming.

## Rate Limiting
Standard RFC RateLimit headers are returned on all API responses:
- `RateLimit-Limit: 120`
- `RateLimit-Remaining: 119`
- `RateLimit-Reset: 60`

## Idempotency
All mutating requests accept `Idempotency-Key` headers.
